headlines.title: Earnings Beat Might Change The Case For Investing In Applied Materials Stock (AMAT)
headlines.summary: Applied Materials reported record Q4 2026 results, with sales of US$10.4b and net income of US$2.7b. The company also issued revenue guidance of US$11.1b for Q1 fiscal 2027, supported by AI chip and equipment demand. The company is tying these strong fundamentals to long term equipment partnerships and its EPIC Center expansion. It is aiming to capture higher value opportunities in advanced packaging, diagnostics, and services linked to AI focused manufacturing.

headlines.title: David Tepper and 25 Other Big Funds Bought Applied Materials Last Quarter, While 27 Sold. Who’s Right?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 26 bought Applied Materials, including David Tepper’s Appaloosa, and 27 sold, including Brad Gerstner’s Altimeter. The selling went beyond Applied: Altimeter also sold all of its KLA shares, and 11 of the sellers added Intel in the same quarter.

description: Applied Materials, Inc. provides materials engineering solutions, equipment, services, and software to the semiconductor and related industries in the United States, China, Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Southeast Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Semiconductor Systems and Applied Global Services (AGS) segments. The Semiconductor Systems segment includes semiconductor capital equipment to enable materials engineering steps, including etch, rapid thermal processing, deposition, chemical mechanical planarization, metrology and inspection, wafer packaging, and ion implantation. The AGS segment offers integrated solutions to optimize equipment and fab performance and productivity comprising spares, upgrades, services, and 200 millimeter and other equipment and factory automation software for semiconductor and other products. It serves manufacturers of semiconductor wafers and chips, and other electronic devices. Applied Materials, Inc. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
